annotations.title: List Regions for an Orderable Product

description: List the regions in which one orderable product can be ordered (catalog, read-only). Read-only catalog: nothing is ordered or charged. To order, price the configuration with preview_order first.

productSlug.description: Product slug from list_orderable_products, e.g. the productSlug field of a product.
